summary: A trustee responsible for a public access rule cannot explain how the supplier picked the pages it blocked.
realLife: Loudoun bought X-Stop, whose developer kept its selection method secret; the court recorded that the software had blocked pages outside the board's policy.
inGame: needs: vendor disclosure and an identified classification error.

turns.pulledBy: A reader identifies a page outside the rule.
turns.writesBack: The board has a concrete error to put to the supplier.

turns.pulledBy: The supplier still does not explain its method.
turns.what: A trustee asks how the board can audit future decisions.
turns.writesBack: Oversight remains an open procurement question.
